add_definitions(-DDIRECTINPUT_VERSION=0x0800)
spec2def(dinput8.dll dinput8.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)
set(DINPUT_SOURCE_FOLDER ../dinput)

# dinput8.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dinput8-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(dinput8_shims OBJECT ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dinput/config.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dinput/data_formats.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dinput/device.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dinput/dinput_main.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dinput/effect_linuxinput.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dinput/joystick.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dinput/joystick_linux.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dinput/joystick_linuxinput.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dinput/joystick_osx.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dinput/keyboard.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dinput/mouse.c)
target_link_libraries(dinput8_shims PRIVATE dxguid uuid wine libcomctl32 libole32 libuser32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(dinput8_shims) # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE and CONST_VTABLE
add_cargo_module(dinput8 dinput8-cargo dinput8.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dinput8_shims psdk uuid_sources)
